label: ivr
scenario: Conversational speech-recognition IVR ('tell me in a few words'), misrecognizes intent, confirms by yes/no, reads claim record and texts a copy.
task: Check the status of Susan Achebe's auto insurance claim.

outcome.confirmation_artifact: system read-back of claim CL47729105; SMS copy sent to number on policy

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thanks for calling Northgate Insurance. I can help with most things right here. so, tell me in a few words what you're calling about.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Susan Achebe to check the status of her auto claim.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: okay. I think you're calling about billing. is that right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: got it. claim status. please say or enter your claim number. it starts with the letters C L.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: C L, four seven seven two, nine one oh five.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I heard. C L. four seven seven two. nine one zero five. is that right?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thanks. one moment while I pull that up.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: claim C L four seven seven two nine one zero five, was approved on september ninth. a payment of. two thousand. one hundred. forty dollars. was issued by direct deposit on. september eleventh. would you like me to text you a copy of this information?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: okay. I'll text it to the mobile number on your policy. is there anything else I can help you with? you can say, file a claim, make a payment, or, I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: thanks for calling Northgate Insurance. goodbye.
